data.summary: Hörakustik Beispielklang invoices Bastian Musterquell €1,400.00 as his own share (Eigenanteil) of new hearing aids, after the health insurer covered the fixed amount; it is due within 30 days of the invoice date (19 November 2026), with instalments possible by arrangement.
data.explanation: This is a private invoice from your hearing-aid acoustician for the part of your new hearing aids that your health insurer's fixed allowance did not cover, including the legal co-payment (Zuzahlung). Pay the €1,400.00 total to the account shown by the deadline the app shows (30 days after the invoice date), or contact the provider if you want to arrange instalments as mentioned in the letter. If you don't pay or arrange a plan, the provider could send reminders or pursue the debt.
data.tax_note: Your personal share of medical costs for hearing aids, including the statutory co-payment, can usually be claimed as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in your tax return; keep this invoice.
